purpose: Fix missing necessary evidence in short-caption compound questions
dataset_role: 15 already-observed same-course development questions, not a held-out test

candidates.full_short: Use all indexed chunks only when their combined text including overlap is at most 12000 characters; otherwise retain hybrid Top-3
candidates.hybrid6: Hybrid candidate pool 10 per route, final Top-6
candidates.split: Original question plus up to 3 rule-split subquestions, hybrid Top-3 per query, interleaved deduplication, max 8 sources; no extra model call

screening: Compare actual selected evidence for known failures and context volume without generating model answers
selection_priority: No invented answers to unanswerable questions
Input/output token use and implementation complexity
generation_check: Validate selected candidate on all 15 development questions, keeping model and answer Prompt unchanged
deployment_scope: Only a verified short-context route may replace Top-3; no long-caption quality claim
quality_reviewer: Codex AI against complete auto captions and actual cited excerpts; human_reviewed remains false
